summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/init.py

Python · Tier A

Opt-in request construction controls; inference engines retain their own KV state.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/builders.py

Python · Tier A

Assemble source-owned helper requests from explicit producer inputs. Drafting, monitor judgment, repair and capability-selection builders preserve their existing delimiters and factual values; only permitted sections move and pure instruction fragments can be reused.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
draft 17 Assemble event, parameter or monitor drafting from explicit instruction/schema/request fields and existing separators. Events omit the request model and accept an explicit clock; parameter drafting retains its existing empty model label. Facts and user strings remain whole sections, never rediscovered by heading searches.
judge 61 Serialize the monitor's supplied identity, command, conditions and exit code alongside its recent output, then assemble the owned monitor-judgment sections. This builds a request and does not execute or schedule the monitor.
repair 90 Split only a recognized bundled full or selected repair template into its fixed instruction/schema/payload/error sections before substitution. Custom bodies render directly as opaque text; only the pure instruction prefix is eligible for fragment reuse.
capability_selection 110 Assemble selected routing instructions into one system message and serialize the current routing input into a separate user message. This projects an existing selection request; it does not choose Skills or grant authority.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/catalog.py

Python · Tier A

Describe editable request sections and project known Task Contract sources. Public previews contain labels and protected boundaries only; the same layout algorithm serves previews and outgoing messages, while custom templates remain opaque.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
sections 12 Build public phase-section labels and add explicit locked authority/tail or Task Context boundaries. These are content-free preview descriptors, not parsed user prompts.
catalogue 43 Use the same ordering function as dispatch to expose original/proposed section labels, conditional markers and no-move reasons for each phase. No private instruction body or model call is needed.
compiler_projection 77 Recognize exact canonical Task Contract persona/routing constructions and assemble their owned sections on a copied message list. Unknown custom templates remain one locked section; an inactive cache policy returns the original messages.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/comparisons.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate explicit bounded original/enabled model experiments. Capture routing and phase options, admit one job per endpoint, enforce physical retry/deadline/cancellation budgets and retain partial evidence. Separate arm clients use synthetic fixtures; returned operations are validated, never executed.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Target 33 Capture a resolved inference target and canonical phase options for one comparison; the combined identity detects changes in routing or generation configuration.
Target.base_url 39 Expose the captured inference endpoint for normalized single-comparison admission.
Target.key 45 Hash the inference identity together with phase options so comparisons detect configuration drift between pairs.
Target.public 50 Combine safe inference metadata with the decoded phase options and output allowance for the explicit start preview.
Target.client 60 Create an independent client for one arm and attach its captured fixture options; no request is dispatched by this accessor.
ExperimentStopped 68 Signal a deliberate cancellation, deadline, setting or comparison-identity stop whose bounded explanation may be shown to the user.
AttemptBudget 74 Enforce the comparison deadline and physical-attempt ceiling independently of logical pair counts. A disable event latches permanently for this experiment, even if settings are re-enabled.
AttemptBudget.changed 85 Latch a stop when the master or diagnostics switch is disabled; a later enabled snapshot does not clear the stop reason.
AttemptBudget.check 91 Raise ExperimentStopped for a latched disable, cancellation event or expired deadline before more work is admitted.
AttemptBudget.dispatch 97 Serialize publication and physical dispatch admission under the policy lock, recheck stop conditions and count at most 64 transport attempts, including compatibility retries.
ComparisonService 111 Run explicit paired synthetic experiments with one active job per effective endpoint and two worker threads. Retain bounded status/history and idempotency tokens, separate arm clients, cancellation sockets and optional trace persistence; generated operations are never dispatched here.
ComparisonService.start 127 Require a known phase, current enabled diagnostics revision and compatible idempotency token. Resolve routing before acquiring the publication lock, revalidate admission, reserve the normalized endpoint and schedule a bounded job. Duplicate matching tokens return existing status; conflicting starts raise without launching another experiment.
ComparisonService.status 200 Return detached job state with the current physical attempt count; an evicted or unknown comparison raises KeyError.
ComparisonService.cancel 211 Latch explicit cancellation and cancel owned sockets for queued/running jobs; completed jobs remain unchanged and return their existing status.
ComparisonService._run 224 Create isolated arm clients, run two warmup and twenty measured pairs with balanced seeded ordering, and retain partial/failed evidence. Fence route/model/input/configuration drift, enforce timer/socket cancellation, summarize correctness separately from latency, release listeners/endpoint ownership and retain only twenty completed jobs. Trace-persistence errors do not discard the in-memory result.
ComparisonService.close 363 Reject new jobs, cancel every active comparison and stop accepting pool work without waiting for in-flight cleanup. Restart does not resume these process-local experiments.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/diagnostics.py

Python · Tier A

Turn numeric request evidence into honest observations and paired-comparison statistics. Provider cache reports remain separate from local rendering savings; deterministic block-bootstrap intervals, baseline failures and correctness regressions constrain performance verdicts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
runtime_report 18 Project request evidence into content-free versioned metrics with explicit provider/local/unknown sources. Provider usage belongs to the final transport attempt; total time spans the logical request. A single observation always reports insufficient comparative evidence.
valid_time 72 Accept finite numeric durations, excluding booleans and optionally allowing zero for component timings. Invalid/missing measurements cannot enter latency statistics.
percentile 82 Return the nearest-rank value from sorted samples, or None for no evidence; this is descriptive and does not create a confidence interval.
interval 89 Estimate a deterministic 95% interval for paired median percentage changes using contiguous blocks of four and the supplied resample count. Fewer than 20 valid pairs yields no interval.
summarize 109 Retain failure/contamination flags and calculate timing statistics only for complete, correct, non-excluded pairs. Apply the predeclared five-percent interval thresholds; an enabled correctness regression overrides a favorable timing verdict. Return paired and per-arm metrics without interpreting cache hits as whole-task speedup.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/fixtures.py

Python · Tier A

Construct synthetic phase inputs and run explicit comparison samples through production request builders, context measurement, scheduling and transport. prepare only builds inputs; sample can call the selected model but never dispatches its proposed operations or adopts them into a real task. Results retain validation, timing and contamination evidence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
execution_state 22 Build a synthetic legacy or Task Context state with a per-pair marker and fake Gateway authority for request-construction tests. This is input data only and does not create a real task or execute the named operation.
prepare 55 Use the production builder for a supported phase and return synthetic request inputs plus a phase-specific correctness predicate. Execution fixtures may use real context preparation with captured options; helper schemas and markers test output contracts. This function constructs requests but performs no generated operations.
sample 264 Run one explicitly requested synthetic model sample under a pinned policy, inference budget, output settings and normal scheduler lease. Observe both arms externally, validate exactly the expected tool/schema/marker result without executing it, record overlap/configuration identities and restore patched client methods/context variables. Validation failures are false correctness; transport/construction failures remain unknown, while cancellation propagates.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/layout.py

Python · Tier A

Pin policy and guidance snapshots around request construction, then reorder only permitted producer-owned sections and reuse bounded pure renders. Keep reversible manifests for context fallback and continuation identities; optional numeric diagnostics are isolated from inference success and durable history.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Section 27 Carry one producer-owned text section with its original delimiter, protected region and optional manifest coordinates. Callers assemble one message at a time; message metadata is descriptive, not an independent cross-message ordering guard.
Binding 41 Hold one request's owner/policy, fragment identity and optional diagnostics, source manifests and reversible layout mappings. These disposable objects are separate from durable task history.
enabled 56 Return whether this context's pinned policy activates any cache feature; unrelated current settings do not alter an in-flight decision.
request_scope 91 Pin guidance/Prompt Editor selection and prompt-cache policy together for a logical request. Guidance still applies when every cache feature is off; nested scopes reuse their parents unless fresh is requested.
_cache_request_scope 107 Capture the controller or explicit experiment snapshot, resolve the existing reuse prohibition and allocate evidence only for enabled diagnostics. At exit publish optional numeric reports and restore the context even if diagnostic recording fails. Off requests do not allocate manifests or extension caches.
scoped 173 Decorate a producer with the specified request phase and owner argument. The wrapper preserves the callable metadata and uses the same nested/fresh scope rules as explicit contexts.
attach_activity 188 Keep measurements in existing trace artifacts, outside durable run state.
constructed 218 Wrap a source builder with construction timing while retaining its original signature metadata and behavior.
construction 230 Measure only the outermost nested construction span when diagnostics are active, accumulating elapsed milliseconds and restoring nesting depth even when a builder raises.
order 250 Partition unlocked contiguous regions, sort only selected slots by declared stability rank and accept a permutation only if its stable prefix improves. Unselected slots, locked boundaries and stable ties are preserved; return a reason when no movement is permitted or useful.
assemble 318 Join exact section text and delimiters, applying the permitted order only under an active policy. Record a deduplicated source manifest and reversible original string when changed, plus at most 32 layout observations. An original-layout fallback deliberately skips reordering.
project_prefix 369 Apply at the final owned boundary, after existing redaction and tail insertion. A transformation that no longer matches the registered assembly makes it opaque. This never rediscovers sections inside user or template content.
render_fragment 393 Look up a pure rendering by owner, phase, renderer version, pinned policy revision, guidance identity and complete inputs before invoking its builder. Disabled, forbidden or stale reuse renders directly; diagnostics count actual hits/misses and timed misses.
original_projection 433 Restore only exact strings registered by this request's own assemblies.
observe 453 Merge normalized provider telemetry into active diagnostics and retain a bounded model identifier. Malformed observation processing is ignored so it cannot fail inference.
checked 466 Record an existing validator's result, without running another check.
dispatched 480 Count a physical transport attempt and reset final-attempt telemetry/first-actionable evidence while retaining the logical request identity and start time.
actionable 491 Record the first actionable streaming observation for the current attempt as elapsed time since logical request start. Later events do not overwrite it.
layout_identity 502 Describe only effective section movements plus active guidance/override identity for continuation compatibility. Diagnostics-only changes and an explicit original-layout fallback add no layout permutation.

src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/policy.py

Python · Tier A

Publish immutable controller prompt-cache preferences without adding hot-path storage reads. PolicyOwner owns bounded fragment caches, numeric observations and setting-change listeners; switches control reordering, extra pure rendering reuse and diagnostics independently of inference-engine KV caching.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
PromptCachingSettings 98 API shape. Publication replaces nested mutable maps with immutable tuples.
PromptCachingSettings.integer_version 113 Require an actual integer before the version-1 Literal check; booleans and stringified numbers are not supported saved versions.
PromptCachingSettings.known_sections 122 Reject unknown phases or protected/unregistered section IDs in the saved reordering map. Missing choices remain unselected rather than becoming implicit permissions.
Policy 133 Store immutable feature flags and per-phase section choices. The master gate is separate from three independent features; retained subordinate choices become effective only when their gates permit them.
Policy.active 143 Report whether the master and at least one feature are enabled, allowing master-on with all features off to preserve the existing path.
Policy.selected 148 Return this phase's explicit reordering choices only when master and reordering are enabled; fragment reuse and diagnostics do not move sections.
Policy.as_dict 153 Serialize the immutable policy into the public versioned settings shape without its publication revision.
PolicySnapshot 167 Pair one immutable policy with its local publication revision so a logical request can retain choices across concurrent settings changes.
PolicyOwner 175 One controller owns publication, new-only bounded caches and numeric evidence.
PolicyOwner.snapshot 196 Return the published immutable snapshot; request readers need neither a storage query nor a mutable settings copy.
PolicyOwner.publish 202 Validate and freeze nested settings, then publish only changed policies under the owner lock. Advance revision, clear extension caches and notify a copied listener list; listener failures are isolated, while invalid settings raise before publication.
PolicyOwner.fragments 227 Return an LRU extension cache for one live owner, retaining at most eight owners. A supplied revision must match the current enabled/reuse policy; stale requests return None and render directly. Each cache separately enforces RequestFragments entry and byte bounds.
PolicyOwner.dispose 247 Remove the extension cache for a disposed owner; a missing identity is already disposed and requires no action.
PolicyOwner.record 253 Detach one observation report and retain at most 64 reports in insertion order. Evidence lives in process memory; trace persistence belongs to callers.
PolicyOwner.observations 263 Return deep copies of retained reports under the lock so API consumers cannot mutate measurement state.
resolve_owner 272 Follow the recognized client/owner wrapper chain for at most ten steps to find a PolicyOwner. Missing ownership stays off; no process-global fallback or storage lookup is introduced.
